dct:title: Equivalence-Anchored Subtree Import — Infectious Diseases
dct:description: Imports 98 new Foundation entities as children of 42 infectious disease leaf nodes, sourced from Mondo descendants of those leaf nodes' exact-match Mondo classes. Each new entity receives a provisional IRI (icd-stage:), a SubClassOf assertion to its Foundation parent, and an EquivalentClasses axiom anchoring it to its Mondo source. Provisional IRIs are rewritten to permanent entity URIs at iCAT submission.

icd:scope.icd:constraint: Foundation leaf nodes (no children) with SSSOM exact match to Mondo (confidence >= 0.9)

icd:iriGovernance.icd:note: Provisional IRIs are batch-scoped and rewritten to permanent Foundation entity IRIs upon editorial board approval and iCAT insertion.

icd:upstream.icd:reason: Axis alignment axioms required for equivalence verification (ELK must treat icd:specificAnatomy ≡ RO:0004026, etc.)

icd:downstream: Synonym enrichment of newly added entities (future batch)

icd:exclusionCriteria: Mondo leaves with no subclasses (anchor yields no candidates)
